passages.text: Mia is learning to write clear labels for the school's small collection of rocks. She hurries through the first card and accidentally misses an important measurement. The teacher tells her to take her time and check one label before starting the next. After Mia corrects three cards carefully, Ben says, “Keep it up; your notes are much clearer now.” She makes a short checklist with spaces for colour, size and the place where each rock was found. By slowing the work and checking each part, Mia finishes labels that other pupils can actually use.

parallelText.en: Mia is learning to write clear labels for the school's small collection of rocks.
parallelText.zh: 米娅正学习给学校的小岩石藏品写清楚标签。

parallelText.en: She hurries through the first card and accidentally misses an important measurement.
parallelText.zh: 她匆忙写完第一张卡，不小心漏掉重要测量数据。

parallelText.en: The teacher tells her to take her time and check one label before starting the next.
parallelText.zh: 老师请她从容一点，开始下一张前先检查一张标签。

parallelText.en: After Mia corrects three cards carefully, Ben says, “Keep it up; your notes are much clearer now.”
parallelText.zh: 米娅仔细改好三张卡后，本说：“继续努力，你的记录现在清楚多了。”

parallelText.en: She makes a short checklist with spaces for colour, size and the place where each rock was found.
parallelText.zh: 她制作简短核对表，留出颜色、大小和发现地点的位置。

parallelText.en: By slowing the work and checking each part, Mia finishes labels that other pupils can actually use.
parallelText.zh: 放慢节奏、逐项核对后，米娅完成了其他同学真正用得上的标签。

passages.text: Our puzzle club borrows a large map from the library for a route-finding game. A couple of pupils hold the corners while Ben reads the instructions aloud. After the game, Mia wants to fold the map quickly and put it back on its shelf. The teacher first checks the original folds so that no new crease cuts across the printed key. We follow those lines together, then place the map in its labelled envelope before returning it. Taking care with a borrowed item keeps the next group from having to solve a problem we created.

parallelText.en: Our puzzle club borrows a large map from the library for a route-finding game.
parallelText.zh: 我们谜题社从图书馆借一张大地图，玩找路线游戏。

parallelText.en: A couple of pupils hold the corners while Ben reads the instructions aloud.
parallelText.zh: 两位学生扶着角，本大声读说明。

parallelText.en: The teacher first checks the original folds so that no new crease cuts across the printed key.
parallelText.zh: 老师先检查原折痕，避免新折痕穿过印好的图例。

parallelText.en: We follow those lines together, then place the map in its labelled envelope before returning it.
parallelText.zh: 我们一起沿原线折好，再把地图放进贴有标签的信封后归还。

parallelText.en: Taking care with a borrowed item keeps the next group from having to solve a problem we created.
parallelText.zh: 仔细对待借来的物品，让下一组不用解决我们造成的麻烦。
